reviews.decision: Root ADR 1062 — compose Table239/240 data in pdf-model, submit at host seam
reviews.verdict: Reaffirm the boundary; source-derived selection gaps are upstream of host policy.
reviews.reason: The field selector is fully document-derived. The host's Send/Ask/Warn/Refuse choice does not change whether the action omitted Fields or named an empty array; the model must preserve that distinction before transmission.

reviews.decision: Root ADR 1198 — Table227 Required is reported at export
reviews.verdict: No change. Required-value reporting is separate from selected-field membership.
reviews.reason: The current Required review handles a selected empty field and host policy. This finding instead concerns whether a field belongs to the selected set at all; an empty Fields array means no selection in the clear branch.

reviews.decision: Root ADR 0753 / reset descendant selection and Errata Collection 3 #174
reviews.verdict: Reaffirm the current descendant behavior; #174 explicitly confirms excluded descendants are spared. Do not attribute the new presence gap to this decision.
reviews.reason: The primary Caret is positioned in Table242’s set branch and explicitly adds the descendants exemption; current tests assert reset descendants and excluded descendants. The separate omission distinction is stated in Table241 and is not changed by #174.

reviews.decision: Table239/241 field_targets representation of an absent or empty Fields entry
reviews.verdict: Current behavior is inconsistent with the source distinction; preserve entry presence before composition/reset.
reviews.reason: Tables 239 and 241 explicitly state the special behavior only when the entry is omitted. An explicit empty array remains present and, with Include/Exclude clear, names no fields. The implementation loses presence when it maps both cases to Vec::new(), so this is a concrete, source-derived selection defect if the scratch regression reproduces the public path.
